notes.title: Syder Reloaded now available with a special offer for Syder Arcade players
notes.content:
Hello Syder pilots! Almost exactly 13 years after the release of Syder Arcade, the remastered version of Studio Evil's first title is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1407150/Syder_Reloaded/]now available on Steam[/url]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5219134/17fae3603353ef179a6684a04c769825b46c23c5.png[/img]

This is not just a new edition, it's a brand new game! Compared to the original title, this is what you can find in Syder Reloaded:
[list]
[*] New and improved graphics
[*] The classic ships have been rebalanced
[*] We added 4 new playable ships
[*] Improved online leaderboards
[*] Improved storytelling, better dialogues and brand new opening and and ending cinematics
[*] New alternative anime character portraits
[*] New enemies
[*] A new boss fight!
[*] Improved levels, some of hem have been rebuilt from the ground-up!
[*] Redesigned powerup and special weapon systems
[*] New score system with combos, grazing and bullet cancelling!
[/list]
We want to thank our community for the unstoppable support (and the incredible patience) we have seen during these years. For you who already own Syder Arcade, you can benefit from the dedicated [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/52414/Syder]Syder Bundle[/url], which will allow you to purchase Syder Reloaded with a special 60% discount for the first month after release.

You can also find Syder Reloaded available on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5. We have partnered with [url=https://www.strictlylimitedgames.com/collections/syder-reloaded]Strictly Limited[/url] to offer a retail limited version for console, which we are very thankful for.

Also, don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/NrtuVugD8N]Discord server[/url]!

Enjoy your space adventure and good luck!

notes.title: Syder Reloaded is Coming to Steam!
notes.content:
Ready for more furiously overcharged, hybrid shmup action? 
[b]Syder Reloaded[/b] is coming to Steam! 

From Spring 2021, [b]Syder Reloaded[/b] revives the [b]Syder[/b] series in this love-letter to Amiga shmups with upgraded graphics and refined gameplay. 

Existing [b]Syder Arcade[/b] players will still be able to play the original iteration, and will receive a very special offer in picking up the new game. More details revealed soon! 

[previewyoutube=1YZrVZ1NC4Q;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1407150/Syder_Reloaded/]WISHLIST SYDER RELOADED ON STEAM[/url] 👈[/h2]


Be among the first to play the game on Steam in the [b]Steam Autumn Festival[/b] from October 7th – 13th. We’ll have a [b]playable demo[/b] live on the new Steam page [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1407150/Syder_Reloaded/]here[/url], showcasing one of the challenge levels and five playable ships. 

We will be [b]livestreaming[/b] during the course of the event, and you can find our stream schedule [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1407150]here[/url]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5219134/a892e1b39b2d4e0549f8f9d67180cebf6f0b8d11.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5219134/c21fbad014cf44234d099f08ac3f230434ffee01.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5219134/c3842bdcfd523c79832b19905ce82dbb62835bac.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5219134/0645611f336b9ed980598c0d09369cd469207510.jpg[/img]

---- 

[h2]What’s New? [/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]‘Tis But a Scratch:[/b] Introducing grazing! Fly in the face of danger and keep your score multiplier alive by flying close to bullets. 

[*] [b]Pick Your Poison:[/b] Shoot powerups to cycle your options. Forget otherwise perfect runs being ruined with random weapon drops. Now you make the call. 

[*] [b]Make Mine a Multi: [/b]Bullet cancelling partially refills the multiplier reset counter. When your special weapon is charged, earn extra score based on your multiplier. 

[*] [b]A Fresh Coat of Paint:[/b] All new graphics and improved level design, boss battles and enemy behaviours. 

[*] [b]Expanded Roster:[/b] Get ready for battle with 4 new playable ships.

[*] [b]Settle The Score:[/b] The scoring system has been redesigned from scratch, rewarding the most skilled players. 
[/list]

[h2]Key Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]6 Legendary Levels:[/b] A challenging Campaign Mode packed with guns, glory, and buckets of adversity for you to overcome!

[*] [b]Choose Your Ship:[/b] Even more superb starships ready to be commanded, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Choose wisely!

[*] [b]How Far Can You Go?:[/b] 3 different Survival and Challenge Mode levels, perfect for pilots wishing to showcase their skills. 

[*] [b]Online Leaderboards:[/b] Take control of the all-new scoring system and make your mark on the Global Leaderboards, or go personal and fight for bragging rights at the top of your friends list. 

[*] [b]Play with What You’ve Got:[/b] Pick up a controller or reach for your keyboard, how you play is up to you.

[*] [b]Travel Back in Time:[/b] Apply a suite of retro graphic filters to change the way you see the game and bring that wonderful hit of nostalgia from the 90s!

[*] [b]No Grind, Just Glory:[/b] Earn your place among the elite, winning badges and high scores based on skill and ability, not hours invested.

[*] [b]Big Bosses Await:[/b] Go head-to-head against monstrously-sized ships. Will you overcome these alien invaders?

[*] [b]A Challenge with Choices:[/b] Pick from up to 4 levels of difficulty, so you can set your own challenge. Rise to the maximum as you master your ship!
[/list]

notes.title: Syder Arcade Update 1.6 is here
notes.content:
The biggest update since Syder Arcade release is availabe on Steam!

- New Playable ship: The Overseer

- 3 New Achievements

- Balance fixes and improvements

You can find the complete change-log in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/252310/discussions/0/630800443390269293/]community hub[/url].

notes.title: Syder Arcade 1.51 Update:
notes.content:
This quick uptate fixes a few bugs and glitches on the Pc version.
Mac version coming in a few days.

- Pressing ESC during level briefing could cause to abort the campaing mode
- Inverted axis on some joypad/controllers. The game should now understand the correct direction
- Controller configuration should display better instructions
- Random exception/error on last level
- Text running out of messageboxes
- Facepalm achievement given when exiting immediately from missions
- Sometimes the leaderboard interface did not disappear
- The "connecting" message did not disappear on leaderboards when connection was not available
- Overlapping text on leaderboards
- Minimap not showing new enemies after few minutes
- Increased joypad deadzone in menus
- Pressing "Special weapon" key on mission start, could cause the camera to do crazy stuff
- Arrows enemy indicator moving randomly
- Disappearing bullets in survival mode
- Fixed some typos and translations
